A's headline is catchier, but its subhead calls the walks 'Reliable', which a new service can't yet back up. A's note also says the subhead leads with the photo when it doesn't. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers deliver all three pieces, invent no social proof, and correctly leave out the insurance and background-check claim until the paperwork is confirmed.
